card.text: Explore Naiad through its Voyager-derived shape model.

introduction.text: Naiad is Neptune’s innermost moon. Its elongated shape is inferred from Voyager observations; the grid marks the absence of a usable surface map.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Voyager-based shape estimate. The outline is measured but local terrain is unresolved; gray grid: no imagery.
